title: Halloween Blackberry Witch Fizz
description: A blackberry, gin and ginger beer fizz for Halloween.
author: Better Sweet Drinks
instructions:
1. Muddle five blackberries with lemon juice and syrup in a shaker.
  2. Add gin and ice; shake for 10 seconds and double-strain into an ice-filled highball glass.
  3. Top with ginger beer, stir once, and garnish with blackberries and rosemary.
notes: Prepare one serving at a time. Add sparkling ingredients only when ready to serve.
